name: subscribe_linear_comment
description: Subscribe this conversation to comments created on Linear issues, scoped to one team or to one individual issue. Delivers one notification per new comment, with that comment's text. It does NOT deliver comment edits, resolutions, or reactions, and it does NOT deliver comments on Linear documents, project updates, or initiative updates (those carry no issue and are dropped). A delivery is one comment, not a thread: earlier replies in the same thread are not included, so read the issue if you need the conversation so far. Project scope is not offered because Linear's comment webhook does not say which project the issue belongs to. Scope ids accept the resource's linear.app URL, its UUID, or its copyable ref — an issue identifier like CHAR-661, or a team key like CHAR — and must belong to the Linear organization your account is connected to. After subscribing, state what you are waiting for and end your turn; the event arrives as a follow-up notification in this conversation.

teamId.description: The team's linear.app URL, UUID, or key (e.g. CHAR).

issueId.description: The issue's linear.app URL, UUID, or identifier (e.g. CHAR-661).
